item.title: To the Bitter End | Patch Notes
item.description:
Generals!

Tomorrow it is time to go above and beyond and To the Bitter End for Romania’s sovereignty and keep their neighbours in check. Accompanying the new Focus Pack is a small update that mainly focuses on re-balancing some aspects of the Eastern Front, where Romania notoriously fought during the war. You of course can make your own decisions and avoid fighting a costly eastern war on the behest of others and carve out your own future.

Drum bun!
